THE RESEARCH TEAM'S NOTES

Why we own it

Why we own Nu is the largest digital bank in Latin America, operating under the Nubank brand across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia. They have 139mn customers with 118mn in Brazil, where it now touches well over half the adult population, 16mn in Mexico, where management says it has become the country's largest digital bank, and 5+mn in Colombia, its earliest-stage market. The product set spans the full retail-banking stack, from deposit accounts, credit cards, personal and secured lending to insurance, investing, and, more recently, Nu Global, a multicurrency account live in 35+ countries offering yield, fee-free FX transfers and crypto trading.
